item.title: [ZEPPELIN-2150] NoSuchMethodError: org.apache.spark.ui.SparkUI.appUIAddress() for the spark master
item.description: This happens on the latest spark master. Because spark remove the method SparkUI.appUIAddress(), and this is private method, we should try to use private method as less as possible. Instead we should use SparkContext.uiWebUrl

status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

GitHub user zjffdu opened a pull request:

https://github.com/apache/zeppelin/pull/2231

ZEPPELIN-2150. NoSuchMethodError: org.apache.spark.ui.SparkUI.appUIAddress() for the spark master

      1. What is this PR for?
        `SparkUI.addUIAddress` is removed in spark master which cause this error. Actually spark 2.0 introduce new api `SparkContext.uiWebUrl` (SPARK-14576) which is public in contrast `SparkUI.addUIAddress` is private. This PR would use `SparkUI.addUIAddress` for spark 1 and `SparkContext.uiWebUrl` for spark 2.
